name: gp2
caption:
GP2 🎮🏀 His dad is a Hall of Famer. Nobody drafted him.

• 2016 draft: undrafted, then years bouncing around the G League
• 2022: NBA champion with us
• Left for Portland, traded back to us in 2023
• First 10 games: 5.0 PPG on 46.8% shooting

Most underrated Warrior of this era? 👇

beats.head: UNDRAFTED
beats.name: GP2
beats.vo: His dad is a Hall of Famer. And nobody drafted Gary Payton the second.
beats.dlg: DAD: HALL OF FAMER.|HIM: UNDRAFTED IN 2016.

beats.head: G LEAGUE
beats.name: GP2
beats.vo: Years in the G League. Ten-day deals. Then we give him a shot.
beats.dlg: YEARS IN THE G LEAGUE...|THEN WE GIVE HIM A SHOT.

beats.head: CHAMPION
beats.name: GP2
beats.vo: Twenty twenty-two: he's an NBA champion. Then he leaves for Portland, and we trade to get him back.
beats.dlg: 2022: NBA CHAMPION.|WE TRADE TO GET HIM BACK.

beats.head: 10 GAMES IN
beats.name: GP2
beats.vo: Through ten games off the bench: five points in thirteen minutes, on forty-seven percent shooting.

beats.head: GP2
beats.vo: Most underrated Warrior of this era? Yes or no? Comment below.

facts.claim: Payton II (nicknamed GP2), son of Hall of Famer Gary Payton, went undrafted in 2016, played in the G League, won the 2022 NBA championship with Golden State, played for Portland, and was traded back to Golden State on February 9, 2023
